pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Frosted Prison.

pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Preparation and combat
pages.text: In the Frosted Prison a Strange Key opens a Door of Seal. Interacting with a fully charged Cursed Tombstone summons the boss; a weak tombstone is not ready. Sidestep rushes and leave grab range, then retaliate after the sequence.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. Start combat from the boss encounter menu. In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Music Disc, Cursium Ingot. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Campaign
pages.text: In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Cold Eye. First record the branch victories: Skor, The Yeti, Frostbitten Golem, Yeti. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
